description: CORS misconfiguration scanner — Live CORS test of one URL: sends crafted Origin headers (arbitrary origin, null, host-prefix and suffix bypasses, untrusted subdomain, plain-HTTP origin) plus a credentialed PUT preflight, and reports which origins are trusted, whether credentials are allowed, reflected origins without Vary: Origin, wildcard misuse and open preflights. Verdict OK/REVIEW/VULNERABLE with severity-ranked findings and fixes; CRITICAL means any website can read responses as the logged-in user. Pass url=. Price: $0.005 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: security_cors_check
